notes.title: Planets and Levels in Kickback Clicker
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45634270/37f8146f9fe94e901913c4f82367690628e669b1.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The next feature coming in the full version of the game is a location system that lets you choose where to go.[/p][p]As you progress, more planets will become available for you to clear, each featuring unique enemies. On each planet, you’ll need to tackle increasingly challenging zones, so you’ll have to think carefully about your upgrades![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3696700/Kickback_Clicker/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Kickback Clicker has undergone many changes since the demo version was released!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45634270/51be281917bdfca6532ce089729817f7785f0024.gif"][/img][/p][p]While Kickback Clicker is still under development, we'd like to share some progress, like a completely new upgrade menu! It will feature a tree-like system which you can easily navigate between missions without any rush.[/p]
